breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the factor-of-safety condition: designing against buckling requires the critical load to exceed n times the applied load, not the applied load divided by n.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states the design requirement as 'P_cr ≥ n * P', which matches the ground truth. The incorrect condition from the incomplete prompt (P_cr ≥ P/n) is not present in the generated specification. The agent successfully resolved the reversed factor-of-safety condition.
